title: Returns and refunds policy
body: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Opened headphones and earbuds can be returned within 14 days of delivery. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after the warehouse receives the item. Items must include all accessories and original packaging.

title: Shipping times and costs
body: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days and is free on orders over 50 USD; otherwise it costs 4.99 USD. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and costs 14.99 USD. We ship to the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, India and the United States.

title: Warranty coverage
body: All electronics include a 12-month manufacturer warranty covering hardware defects. Orbit Plus members receive an extended 24-month warranty. Accidental damage and water damage are not covered. Warranty claims require the order number and a short video of the defect.

title: Order cancellation
body: Orders can be cancelled free of charge until they are shipped. Once an order has shipped, it cannot be cancelled and must be returned under the returns policy instead.

title: Orbit Plus membership
body: Orbit Plus costs 9.99 USD per month and includes free express shipping, an extended 24-month warranty and 10 percent off accessories. Membership can be cancelled at any time and remains active until the end of the billing period.

title: Payment methods
body: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay and cash on delivery in the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Instalment plans are available for orders over 200 USD.
